title: Correcting the assumption in a negative question
focus: A negative information question can assume something that is not true. Miksi sinä et tule? — Minä tulen.
targetSkills: Correcting the assumption in a negative question

exercises.prompt: Correct the assumption: Answer “Miksi sinä et tule?”: choose “I am coming.”
exercises.explanation: Singular refers to one person or one thing in these patterns. A pronoun stands in place of a name or noun. State the true affirmative situation clearly: Minä tulen (“I am coming”). Kyllä can emphasize the correction: Tulen kyllä (“I am coming, actually”). Here prompts explicitly request a correction. A mere kyllä or ei does not give a clear correction of the assumed action. The complete reply means “I am coming”.
requiredSkills: Correcting the assumption in a negative question
exercises.targetSkill: Correcting the assumption in a negative question
